thesis: The bear narrowly carries the immediate-entry decision because the bullish case itself waits for consolidation, while RSI is 81.75 and no price margin of safety is authenticated. Neutral does not deny the strong trend; it distinguishes an attractive business and relative-strength signal from a currently comfortable execution point.
strongest_counterexample: Comparable sales and profit growth, higher year-ago FCF, modest leverage, positive MACD and supportive dated news supply several independent positives that could allow the trend to continue without a deep pullback.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward buy after RSI falls below 70 while price remains above SMA50 for five consecutive closes and the next sales update retains positive year-over-year growth.
Reconsider toward sell if two consecutive comparable reports show revenue decline and operating margin below the current observation.
evidence_gaps: Authenticated valuation and expected return at the current price.
Durability versus pull-forward of recent demand.
Membership renewal and normalized comparable-sales economics.
decisive_factors: RSI 81.75 and recent rapid advance make entry stretched.
The bull concedes consolidation should precede a controlled entry.
